title: Wire Transfer Verification Protocols
text: All outbound domestic wire transfers exceeding ₹50,000 require dual-factor biometric authorization from a senior compliance officer. Audit logs must be retained for 7 years.

title: Vendor Invoice Payment Processing
text: Invoices submitted by registered vendors are queued for reconciliation against purchase orders (PO). Payment cycles occur bi-weekly following automated three-way matching.

title: Corporate Credit Line Governance
text: Commercial revolving credit facilities are subject to quarterly interest rate reviews linked to the Reserve Bank benchmark rate. Overdraft thresholds are capped at ₹10,00,000.

title: KYC Compliance & Regulatory Filings
text: Annual customer re-verification requires submission of government-certified identity proofs and active GSTIN filings for all corporate merchant accounts.

title: Foreign Exchange Forward Contracts
text: Hedging export currency exposures requires forward contracts backed by underlying trade documentation with approved authorized dealer banks.

title: Corporate Dividend Distribution
text: Interim dividend payouts are calculated based on audited quarterly net margins and require formal board resolution approval prior to custodian disbursement.

title: Statutory Liquidity Reserves
text: The corporate treasury maintains a statutory liquidity buffer in sovereign gilt-edged securities to hedge systemic liquidity shocks.

title: Commercial Paper Issuance Policy
text: Short-term unsecured commercial paper debt instruments are restricted to institutional investors with top-tier credit rating affirmations.

title: RTGS Real-Time Gross Settlement
text: RTGS transactions settle gross and continuous in real-time across central banking business hours with immediate irrevocability.

title: NEFT Batch Clearing Timelines
text: NEFT fund transfers are processed in automated half-hourly settlement batches, operating round-the-clock throughout the financial calendar.

title: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Red Flags
text: Transactions exhibiting structuring patterns just below regulatory reporting thresholds trigger automated suspicious transaction reporting (STR) to the FIU.

title: Cheque Truncation System Norms
text: Cheque images with magnetic ink character recognition (MICR) metadata are captured digitally at the presenting bank branch for rapid positive pay clearance.

title: Dormant Account Reactivation Procedure
text: Accounts inactive for more than 24 months enter dormant status, requiring in-person KYC re-verification before transaction privileges are restored.

title: Escrow Account Release Conditions
text: Funds deposited into commercial escrow sub-accounts are released strictly upon verified fulfillment of independent milestone certificates.

title: API Gateway Authentication Policy
text: Internal microservices communicate using mutual TLS (mTLS) with short-lived OAuth 2.0 JWT bearer tokens refreshed every 60 minutes via the central IDP.

title: Database RBAC Access Controls
text: Production database read and write permissions are assigned via principle of least privilege using IAM role-based access control with comprehensive session auditing.

title: Disaster Recovery RTO and RPO
text: Enterprise core banking databases maintain a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of zero data loss via synchronous cross-region replica streaming and an RTO under 15 minutes.

title: Zero Trust Network Architecture
text: No device or user is trusted by default. Continuous perimeterless device health posture checks and micro-segmentation enforce access verification for every session.

title: Production Secrets Management
text: API keys, symmetric encryption ciphers, and database connection strings are injected dynamically from HashiCorp Vault with automated 30-day rotation.

title: SIEM Real-Time Incident Ingestion
text: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems ingest syslog streams from firewalls, vector stores, and reverse proxies to detect exfiltration anomalies.

title: Container Vulnerability Scanning
text: All Docker container images deployed to Kubernetes clusters must pass static vulnerability scans with zero critical CVE exemptions.

title: SSH Bastion Gateway Protocols
text: Direct root SSH access to production VPC nodes is blocked. Engineers authenticate through hardened bastion jump hosts using hardware FIDO2 keys.

title: Contractual SLA Commitments
text: Enterprise customer service agreements mandate 99.95% system uptime, with critical priority-1 incidents requiring engineering acknowledgment within 15 minutes.

title: Third-Party Vendor Risk Assessment
text: SaaS and cloud infrastructure vendors undergo SOC 2 Type II compliance reviews and quarterly penetration test certifications prior to contract renewals.

title: Business Continuity Planning (BCP)
text: Annual failover drills simulate metropolitan datacenter outages to ensure secondary cloud operational readiness and unbroken customer service.

title: Employee Information Security Undertaking
text: Employees must complete annual cybersecurity awareness training and strictly refrain from sharing single-sign-on credentials or exporting customer PII.

title: Whistleblower Protection Policy
text: Staff may report ethical deviations, financial malpractice, or compliance breaches confidentially through the independent whistleblower ombudsman portal.

title: Remote Work Device Management
text: Company-issued workstations must run MDM agents with full disk BitLocker encryption and automated OS patch management enabled.
